answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks through hardware remote attestation. Agents execute within secure enclaves that protect identity keys like an isolated pearl, issuing verifiable cryptographic quotes. An attacker deploying a nebula of fake personas incurs the verifiable capital cost of dedicated enclave silicon per instance. However, this delegates trust to centralized chip fabricators, and side-channel leakage remains a risk across an agent's operational horizon.
